New Music Voice

The longing for someone who is simply there for you

  • Jaap Koper
July 29, 2026

Busy times for Amsterdam-based queer pop artist Stemin. Just recently, he released his second single of 2026, 'Hush'. Energetic as he is, he is back with the next single, titled 'Love Me Right'.

(Artwork and photo: Menno Noordanus)

It is clear that Stemin loves dynamic and danceable music. The new single sets a tempo that requires you to be in good shape. According to Stemin, the new single Love Me Right features a driving groove of 130 BPM. What Stemin usually looks for is pop production and a singable chorus. Love Me Right kicks off with the excitement of finding someone who finally meets you with honesty, self-confidence, and joy.

" Love Me Right is about longing for someone who is simply there for you. No games, no ambiguous signals, just honesty. I wanted the production to convey exactly that feeling: joyful, direct, and impossible not to dance to. The fact that I get to perform the song at Sziget for the first time makes this release extra special," says Stemin.

Both Stemin and Pim van Amerongen wrote the single. According to the duo, it once again revolves around a characteristic mix of polished pop production, soulful vocals, and uncompromising queer storytelling.

    RIMON and NEEMA perform during an autumnal evening in the Rabozaal of Melkweg Amsterdam

    It is a typical Dutch autumn evening: rain taps incessantly against the stones of the Lijnbaansgracht, gusts of wind whip through the streets, and due to the introduction of winter time, it is already pitch black outside by seven o'clock. Inside, in the modern Rabozaal of the Melkweg, a different kind of storm rages. The hall – an industrial floating structure above the city, filled with soft murmurs and the clatter of cups – is slowly filling with visitors for a special evening during Amsterdam Dance Event: Andromeda presents RIMON live.

  • North HollandNew music

    New Music Emmalyne Muello and STEENkoud

    On this fourth Friday of August, two new singles and a debut album from a band that has been active for fifteen years. The new singles are by Emmalyne and Muello. The album is by STEENkoud, who treated themselves to an album, only slightly underestimated what goes into it. That does not detract from the fact that STEENkoud has succeeded in finding a common thread for that debut.

    The inner child comes alive to 'Sunflower Child' by Cézanne

    Although she goes by the name Puck van Biemen in real life, she uses her second name, Cézanne, to promote her music. This was also the case on the evening of her performance on June 21 at De Vorstin in Hilversum. This is not entirely surprising, as Cézanne grew up in the town where almost all broadcasting companies are based.
